pin.pin_01M81FXWBJAGWM7HTN3FEWDEF4.title: Bayside Apartments, 201
pin.pin_01M81FXWBJAGWM7HTN3FEWDEF4.descr: Boobie's apartment in Bayside, near the Jack of Hearts. He lets Jason and Lucia stay in it from Welcome to Vice City (Chapter 3) until Valentina moves them out in Chapter 4.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBKJQQBPM2WA92HEGRT.title: Starlet Motel
pin.pin_01M81FXWBKJQQBPM2WA92HEGRT.descr: Jason and Lucia's motel room in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County: their safehouse in Chapter 2, until Checking Out moves them to Vice City for good.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBK93JXZANTN5Q9JTDD.title: Ambrosia Raceway Park
pin.pin_01M81FXWBK0N9R40DVWPBVSZR8.title: Fleeca Field
pin.pin_01M81FXWBK0N9R40DVWPBVSZR8.descr: A sports stadium in Rockridge, Vice City, based on LoanDepot Park in Miami.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBKPRC9V2QN4C0TPTVX.title: Gellhorn International Raceway
pin.pin_01M81FXWBKPRC9V2QN4C0TPTVX.descr: A race track near Port Gellhorn. It appears to draw on the real Sebring International Raceway.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBK5ZRP1GW82NZH07NW.title: Lake Leonida
pin.pin_01M81FXWBK5ZRP1GW82NZH07NW.descr: The large lake in the middle of Leonida, next to Ambrosia. It is the game's version of Lake Okeechobee.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBK5S601NDP6223NETM.title: Leonida Penitentiary
pin.pin_01M81FXWBK5S601NDP6223NETM.descr: The prison where Lucia served time before the story begins.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBKKAJFMMSYQHT6878T.title: Ocean View Hotel
pin.pin_01M81FXWBKKAJFMMSYQHT6878T.descr: The iconic hotel from GTA Vice City returns, on Shore Drive, Ocean Beach.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM0MQ980SS9VJBSMZS.title: Mount Kalaga National Park
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM0MQ980SS9VJBSMZS.descr: A national park on Leonida's northern border, with hunting, fishing and off-road trails. Its canyon appears to be inspired by Providence Canyon in Georgia.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM6JFE3ZXD9MJ1Y2ZX.title: Port Vice City
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM6JFE3ZXD9MJ1Y2ZX.descr: The port of Vice City, which Rockstar calls the cruise ship capital of the world. It is based on PortMiami.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMH0A2NHENSEXP6J2F.title: Sahara Arena
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMH0A2NHENSEXP6J2F.descr: An indoor arena on the Downtown Vice City waterfront, home of the Vice City Narcos. It is the game's version of Miami's Kaseya Center.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMQ3FSETGH79QP8X63.title: Vice City International Airport
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMQ3FSETGH79QP8X63.descr: The airport of Vice City, modeled after Miami International Airport.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM87CBC2CQ6DDKXFZ3.title: Megamundo Building
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM87CBC2CQ6DDKXFZ3.descr: A skyscraper in Downtown Vice City, home of the Megamundo TV network, modeled after Miami's One Biscayne Tower. In the Extended Look, Jason and Lucia enter it as private security.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMW6B53MGAR13V7CNB.title: The Rusty Anchor
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMW6B53MGAR13V7CNB.descr: A bar in Key Lento, Leonida Keys, seen in Rockstar's Leonida Keys screenshots.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM2YX6ZFBAT38SFA7K.title: Evergreen Shopping Mall
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM2YX6ZFBAT38SFA7K.descr: A shopping mall in Waning Sands, Leonard County.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM8SD7NN65YFSCMBFT.title: Pegassi Residences North Tower
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM8SD7NN65YFSCMBFT.descr: The north one of the two curved Pegassi Residences towers on Tequesta Retreat (Brickell Key), Vice City, which appear in Rockstar's Vice City screenshots.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM1NTFER35VXACNWT8.title: Pegassi Residences South Tower
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM1NTFER35VXACNWT8.descr: The south one of the two curved Pegassi Residences towers on Tequesta Retreat (Brickell Key), Vice City, which appear in Rockstar's Vice City screenshots.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMD3C7M0H2ZMHBRECB.title: Vice City Ferris Wheel
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMD3C7M0H2ZMHBRECB.descr: The Ferris wheel on the Downtown waterfront, next to the Sahara Arena. It goes without a name so far and is modeled after the Skyviews wheel at Miami's Bayside Marketplace.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM5BTF8F6RPPTWYAQ2.title: Stockyard Walls
pin.pin_01M81FXWBM5BTF8F6RPPTWYAQ2.descr: The murals of Stockyard, Vice City's answer to Miami's Wynwood. More than 50 real street artists made murals for GTA 6, some of them here.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMKTDR58F565K6BA96.title: Grassrivers
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMKTDR58F565K6BA96.descr: The wild heart of Leonida: a vast swamp of mangroves and gators, with stranger and deadlier things hidden below the surface.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMRKYE7DS1PW0JS7M2.title: Leonida Keys
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMRKYE7DS1PW0JS7M2.descr: A chain of laid back tropical islands: casual dress, loaded bars and deck chairs, on the edge of some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in America.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMGGKYZVKZ9HZ1HJS3.title: Vice City Oceanarium
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMGGKYZVKZ9HZ1HJS3.descr: A marine park in Catalan Key, based on the Miami Seaquarium in Virginia Key.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMQY51WCZNKWDPJ4A8.title: Thrillbilly Mud Club
pin.pin_01M81FXWBMQY51WCZNKWDPJ4A8.descr: A muddy, off-road park, inspired by Florida's real-world Redneck Mud Park.
pin.pin_01M81FXWBN5SFAVQY90GFZ9W7B.title: Rideout Customs
pin.pin_01M81FXWBN5SFAVQY90GFZ9W7B.descr: Ultimate Edition exclusive; Mod shop known for its custom rims and interiors. Part of the Ultimate Edition; Specialty: Donks
